title: Counter with a step
summary: Keep a number in state, step it by a prop and never let it go below zero.
prompt: Finish `Counter`. Show "Count: N". "Increment" adds `step` (default 1). "Decrement" subtracts `step` but never goes below 0. "Reset" goes back to 0.
hints: Use the updater form, `setCount(c => c + step)`, whenever the next value depends on the previous one.
